## Summary
Adds **Use Case E4 - Tamper-Evident Evidence for Audit and Dispute Resolution** to the Safety and Compliance category of `working-documents/USE-CASES.md`, plus Empire Labs' priorities for the appendix matrix.

## What's included
- **E4 use case**: can a regulated org prove what an agent actually did, to an auditor or a court? Requires Merkle-chained signed event records, WORM storage, RFC 3161 timestamps, approval chains, declared-vs-observed linkage, and a comparable evidence-grade ladder.
- **Prior work references**: the [witnessos](https://github.com/narko4u/witnessos) evidence-grade ladder (E0 Declared -> E4 Anchored) and [eu-ai-act-compliance-grade](https://github.com/narko4u/eu-ai-act-compliance-grade) as reference models for grading evidence strength.
- **Priority matrix contribution**: Empire Labs Pty Ltd (Security Division) priorities - High on E1-E4 + F1, reflecting evidence-grade observability focus.

## Context
E4 extends the existing E1-E3 compliance cluster and gives the Agent Behavior Trace Model a concrete integrity requirement beyond observability. Open to feedback from the WG.
